name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Collateral-free working capital loan to urban and peri-urban street vendors.
benefits: Working capital loan starting at ₹10,000 with 7% interest subsidy, up to ₹50,000 on prompt repayment
documents_required: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body Letter

criteria.description: Applicant must be a self-employed vendor or informal worker
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not in self-employed or informal street trade

criteria.description: Must have an active bank account
criteria.disqualification_reason: Bank account required for loan disbursement
